patch.value: Renew only affected handoff obligations after source revisions change
Receiver-specific repair deltas over immutable acknowledged handoff contracts, using native tracker comments without another store.

One changed dependency in a 50-item packet yields one affected-obligation group; unchanged acknowledgments remain valid; renewal against an old target revision is refused; typed SDK and CLI expose compact bounded TOON/JSON and remedies; seeded state model covers at least 500 sequences and competing transitions at every step; non-git public tracker validation and npm/Bun CI release gates pass.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap rechecked against the pinned CLI SDK, pm-context freshness and handoff generation, pm-review and pm-ops, and existing handoff.ts. Native comments own durable receipts and atomic ifAbsent append; listAllComplete plus certifyCompleteListResult own source completeness. Existing show marks the entire packet stale, and context-freshness validates source manifests; neither computes receiver-specific obligation repair. Implement repair/renew on the existing immutable Decision contract, grouping each focus and uncovered evidence root by its transitive blocker closure; shared questions/assumptions apply conservatively to each focus group. No new handoff store or import/sync engine.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Implemented typed inspectHandoffRepair/renewHandoff and repair/renew CLI commands. Group targets bind the immutable contract to complete native source rows, including update coordinates. Native token-owned lease spans planning through verification; native ifAbsent append owns durable receipt idempotency; foreign receipt-shaped comments are skipped with indexed reasons. The 50-row acceptance scenario passes: one changed dependency yields one group and 24 unchanged acknowledgments. Seeded 500-sequence SDK readback test and every-boundary interleaving tests are running; local typecheck, test typecheck and docstring lint pass.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Behavioral revert proof: replacing group-level preservation in repairSnapshot with legacy whole-packet invalidation makes the 50-row acceptance test fail (25 groups instead of 1). Restored the implementation afterward. Public main snapshot 6f93af2 measured 95 source items with zero source writes; a separate disposable derived tracker seeds 3 groups and one edit, then read-only measurement yields 1 affected group, 2 preserved acknowledgments, 694 delta JSON bytes versus 1040 packet bytes, 530 conservative tokens and 99 ms; renewal yields 3 valid acknowledgments. Seeded model exposed native no-op operations; the reference now explicitly permits unchanged SDK state rather than requiring a write for every input.
